edition.intro: This week's edit is all about getting more from what you own, from flats and boots to jeans in surprising shades, with a few smart buys for the cold months ahead.

items.title: 7 Celebrity-Approved Ways to Wear Flats With Jeans This Fall
items.snippet: Stylish celebrities confirm that the timeless duo is also one of the coolest.
items.headline: Seven Ways to Wear Flats With Jeans This Fall
items.summary: Elle rounds up celebrity outfits that show how easily ballet flats, loafers, Mary Janes and other flat styles work with denim. The looks range from a trench and mom jeans to a white shirt with bootcut jeans, plus trending touches like burgundy, jazz-style and textured flats.
items.tip: Pair the flats you already own with your best-fitting jeans and add one layer, like a trench or a chunky sweater, to make it look planned.

items.title: Black Boots and a Midi Skirt Are Fall's Most Versatile (and Easy) Outfit Formula
items.snippet: Your favorite style combo is getting a fresh upgrade.
items.headline: Black Boots and a Midi Skirt: Fall's Easiest Formula
items.summary: Glamour says the combination of tall black boots and a midi skirt is the most flexible outfit of the season. The skirt's calf-grazing length lets the boots show, and the pairing works with anything from knits to blouses, then carries into winter with tights and a coat.
items.tip: Pull out a midi skirt and your black boots, then try them with a sweater you already love.

items.title: My Mum Asked What Chic Over-50s Are Wearing This Winter—5 Trends That’ll Make You Look In The Know
items.headline: What Stylish Over-50s Are Wearing This Winter
items.summary: Who What Wear looks at five winter trends embraced by chic women over 50, including dramatic opera coats, touches of gold, dresses layered over trousers and knee-length skirts. The writer stresses buying with intention and choosing pieces that age well rather than chasing everything new.
items.tip: Try layering a slip or satin dress over trousers you own, and add a blazer to keep it grounded.

items.title: I'm a Frugal Fashion Editor—This Cost Effective Trend is the Secret to Two Different Jackets for the Price Of One
items.headline: Reversible Jackets: Two Looks for the Price of One
items.summary: Reversible jackets are making a comeback, offering two textures or colors in a single coat. The piece highlights options from high-street to luxury, and suggests they're a smart pick if you want more variety from one purchase.
items.tip: If you need a new coat, check the reversible options first, and make sure both sides work with what you already wear.

items.title: Forget Blue, Brown Jeans Are the Only Pants I’m Wearing With Heels This Fall
items.headline: Why Brown Jeans Are Worth Wearing With Heels
items.summary: Glamour argues that brown jeans are a fresh alternative to blue, black and gray, especially when styled with heels. It suggests wide-leg pairs with a striped rugby shirt, brown with black accessories, or lighter retro-style pairs with suede ankle boots.
items.tip: Wear brown trousers or jeans with black shoes and a black belt for a simple, grown-up combination.

items.title: 18 Best Raincoats for Men 2026, According to GQ Editors
items.snippet: These stylish, impenetrable toppers will have you praying for storms.
items.headline: The Best Men's Raincoats, Tested by GQ
items.summary: GQ's editors tested a range of raincoats and picked favorites across technical shells, a lower-priced option and classic waxed cotton. The takeaway is that a good rain jacket can be the centerpiece of an outfit, not just something that keeps you dry.
items.tip: Before buying anything new, check that your current rain jacket fits well and add it to your outfit planning on wet days.

items.title: Athena Calderone Leans Into the "Grandeur and Glamour" of Holiday Dressing
items.snippet: This under-$160 Aritzia dress is her perfect festive find.
items.headline: Athena Calderone on Leaning Into Holiday Glamour
items.summary: The designer and author talks about turning up the glamour for the holidays with an elegant satin dress, simple silver accents and a restrained approach to accessories. She favors a neutral palette with occasional wine or oxblood tones, and keeps her pieces comfortable and timeless.
items.tip: Choose one shiny accent, like a silver hair pin or metallic shoes, to dress up a simple outfit for a party.

practice: Start with your closet: pull out your jeans, a midi skirt if you have one, black boots, and any flats or loafers. Try three outfits: flats with your best jeans and a trench or cardigan, boots with the skirt and a cozy sweater, and a satin or slip dress layered over trousers with a blazer. If a coat is on your list, put your existing one through the same test before buying.

If you do spend, keep it to one or two pieces that work across these looks: a well-made pair of black boots or flats, or brown trousers or jeans that go with the shoes you own. A reversible jacket can be a smart buy if both sides suit your wardrobe. Finish with small touches, like a belt, a silver pin or a scarf, so the outfits feel fresh without adding much to your budget.
